comments.text: 🙏 Sky burial may be the most striking tradition: once consciousness is gone, the body is viewed as an empty vessel and offered to vultures as a final act of generosity.

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The craziest part is that Tibetans carry the DNA of Denisovans—a branch of humanity that went extinct 50,000 years ago! This specific gene (EPAS1) allows them to breathe easily at 4,500m without their blood thickening or straining their hearts like ours would. Evolution isn't ancient history; it is literally breathing through the nomads on the 'roof of the world.' Absolutely mind-blowing! Did anyone else get goosebumps at this part? 🧬🏔
